Distinct weathered expressive faces, natural hands, modest practical clothing, quiet communal dignity. Full figures with ordinary boots or soft shoes visible, not caricatures or battle poses.

Economical cloth folds and grouped hair locks, no dense microtexture or smooth photographic shading. Tent, rolling distant hills and sparse grass lightly outlined, much fainter than people, fading to nearly white ivory paper. Fire suggested only with brown line strokes, no orange color. Approximately 16:10 landscape composition with group comfortably spread across frame and generous pale margins; include all heads, staffs, feet, goat and cookware, no cropped figures. No text, border, watermark, full color or painted lighting. Six people and one goat only.
